module.purpose: Client-rendered team and organization booking page that displays team identity, biography, event types, members, subteams, privacy states, and booking navigation.
module.summary: This client component renders public team or organization pages across several route shapes, adapting links for organization domains and embedded contexts. It derives display metadata, records page-view telemetry, supports member visibility through a query toggle, presents event types and subteams, and conditionally exposes booking actions according to privacy and configuration flags. Unpublished entities receive a dedicated placeholder state.
module.businessContext: Serves the scheduling product's public team and organization pages. If it fails, visitors cannot discover event types, subteams, or member-booking paths.
functions: TeamPage (~L35-239): Renders team, organization, event type, member, and booking views
EventTypes (~L71-109): Lists team event types with links and attendee avatars
SubTeams (~L111-150): Lists organization subteams or an empty-state message
